author: _BillGates
body:
Well first I'm gonna start saying why I joined MCZone:

It was around June and October I was really bored and my friends didnt talk to me alot, one day I went to my school library to get a book when I saw this kid called Antonio playing Minecraft on the computer, I started watching him playing and I tought what he was doing was really fun so I asked him: "Whats dat serve IPee?" and he said play.mczone.co .
 When I got Home that day the first thing I did was enter on MCZone, it was simply AWESOME I spent Hours playing it until I needed to sleep.
 The next day when I got at school I told my friends Let's play an epic game today at the library.
 At recess me and my friends went straight to the library computer, we isntalled minecraft and played MCZone, it was the best 30 minutes with my friends of my Life, and we played MCZone till November 22...
 When Avicus realesed we were very Hyped, we tought Avicus would beat MCZone 2873456345638 times but No, NO it was a sh*t. Hackers everywhere lag more lag and guess what? LAG!

We stopped playing on it but at home I still played on it but nowadays I have started to stop playing on Avicus, the removal of CTW on Nebula, Survival Games, the Parkour that never came all of that I miss alot, Nexus isnt that fun anymore ;(

And now the worst part what I most miss about MCZone:
The FUN!

Avicus isnt about Fun and help your team do the objective its about get more XP and screw up your team.


This is NOT a leaving post!
This is a post to try Bringing back the Fun from MCZone, please post your Ideas to help bring back the Fun to the server.
